entities.name: Muhammad Akhlaq Ahmed
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Muhammad Akhlaq Ahmed was a Pakistani field hockey player. He won a bronze medal at the 1992 Summer Olympics in Barcelona. He died of cancer on 25 November 2016 at the age 44.
